title: Personalised cancer vaccine expected to be approved next year | New Scientist
description: A bespoke vaccine that is tailored to target an individual's unique skin cancer reduced rates of recurrence or death in a late-stage trial, making an approval expected
author: Carissa Wong

title: Brazil presidential election dogged by alleged bias by Meta AI tools | New Scientist
description: Supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva have accused Meta of interfering in Brazil’s election by making it easier to generate campaign content promoting his rival, Flávio Bolsonaro
author: Luke Taylor

title: Body temperature may drive the higher risk of autoimmune conditions in women | New Scientist
description: Autoimmune conditions are much more common in women than men, which could partly be due to the fluctuating body temperatures that occur during the menstrual cycle and menopause
author: Carissa Wong

title: Tiny 'solar flares' recreated in the lab may explain corona mystery | New Scientist
description: An experiment has produced nanoflares similar to those seen on the sun, and shown that they can help explain why the outer layers of the solar atmosphere are so hot
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Earth entered its 'bad decades' after dinosaur-ending asteroid strike | New Scientist
description: We now have a clearer picture of what happened in the decades following the asteroid impact that led to the extinction of almost all dinosaurs
author: James Woodford

title: All tropical coral reefs could collapse within 50 years | New Scientist
description: Shallow-water coral reefs are at high risk of disappearing by 2075, the IUCN has warned at a UN biodiversity conference. The loss would decimate fisheries and speed up coastal erosion
author: Alec Luhn
